# clavis secrets rollback

<p class="cli-lead">Create a new version from an old one</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets rollback KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Restore an older version by writing it as a new version. History is never rewritten.

## Examples

```sh
clavis secrets rollback DATABASE_URL --version 4
```

## Flags
